text:
deploybot: Canary deploy for `release/v2.8.1` blocked by policy checks :warning:
deploybot: SBOM policy: transitive-license: 'GPL-2.0' detected in package 'lib-omega@1.3.2' (path: service-a -> util-foo -> lib-omega). Policy: deny_transitive_high.

sasha: ugh. which image/build produced that SBOM?

deploybot: build 2026-06-12T14:02Z (artifact: gcr.io/redwood/service-a:v2.8.1-20260612). SBOM: https://ci.internal/sbom/20260612/service-a.json

lizzy_engineer: I can reproduce locally. lib-omega is a transitive pulled in by `util-foo@0.9.0`. Looks like util-foo@0.9.0 recently bumped dependency.

omar_sec: tagging in security: @lizzy_engineer thanks. Quick checklist: 1) confirm if GPL-2.0 is runtime or dev-time only, 2) confirm exposure to customers (shipping binary), 3) propose mitigation or request exception with compensating controls.

ben_pm: timeline: we were planning to promote canary at 15:00 PT. If this blocks, what’s the rollback/fallback?

lizzy_engineer: minimal risk fix: pin `util-foo` to 0.8.x which doesn't pull lib-omega. Patch diff is tiny. Can push hotfix -> rebuild.

ci-bot: quick snippet to pin in package.json:
```
"dependencies": {
  "util-foo": "^0.8.7",
  ...
}
```
Rebuild command: `ci pipeline run --job service-a-build --ref hotfix/pin-util-foo`

omar_sec: if team does pin, open an SBOM regneration and attach results. Security will still need a short exception ticket if any customer-facing binary includes GPL components. But pin > rebuild should avoid that.

sasha: lizzy, can you create the hotfix PR and the short release note blurb? Ben, if we miss the 15:00 canary we should schedule the window at 17:00 PT.

lizzy_engineer: creating PR now. title: "hotfix(pin): lock util-foo to 0.8.x to avoid transitive GPL". Will include CI artifact link + new SBOM.

deploybot: Note: additional vuln scan flagged CVE-2025-3347 (medium) in `lib-omega` as well. Not exploitable in our image if pinned out, but re-run scan after rebuild.

omar_sec: good catch. After PR lands, security will validate SBOM + run SCA. If any remaining finding, we can do a controlled canary with telemetry gating (10% traffic, kill switch).

ben_pm: agree to delay to 17:00 PT unless we see green earlier. Update release notes to call out that this was a dependency pin (no user-facing changes).

lizzy_engineer: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/service-a/pull/2877 -- CI started. New artifact: gcr.io/redwood/service-a:v2.8.1-20260612-hotfix1

ci-bot: build succeeded. SBOM regenerated: https://ci.internal/sbom/20260612/service-a-hotfix1.json

omar_sec: running SCA.. one transitive reference remains in dev graph only. Security verdict: no exception required. Recommend proceed with canary at 17:00 with telemetry gating.

sasha: thanks everyone. ben, please confirm release note and change window in the release doc.

ben_pm: added note to release notes and updated the change window to 17:00 PT. Proceeding with canary rollout at 17:00 with 10% telemetry gate. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Canary started at 17:00 PT. Route: canary(10%) -> stable fallback. Monitor: latency/errors/quality.

lizzy_engineer: observing metrics now, no errors.

omar_sec: closing loop on SBOM policy violation. No action needed beyond the pin. Documented in security-triage ticket #SEC-1421.

ben_pm: awesome, marking release as resumed.

sasha: great coordination, thanks team :raised_hands:
